say:1:1732245601:1.text: As you said, that was "before." We have to look ahead.
say:1:1732245601:1.source_cn: 你也说了，那是“之前”。我们总是要向前看得。
say:1:1732245601:1.male: As you said, that was "before." We have to look ahead.
say:1:1732245601:1.female: As you said, that was "before." We have to look ahead.

say:2:1732245602:1.text: That's right. The Queen can't be the one calling the shots for Savannah and the entire Lightbearer Empire!
say:2:1732245602:1.source_cn: 没错，赛凡纳，乃至整个耀光帝国不能再是她一个人说了算！

say:3:1732245603:1.text: I propose the establishment of a council led by House Augusta!
say:3:1732245603:1.source_cn: 我建议设立以奥古斯塔家族为中心的联合议会！
